review_note: Pinned chow.tex lemma at source line 14657 independently checked against proof-masked source: On the pinned Dedekind-type one-dimensional base, the specified cycle exterior product over S has dimension shift −1 and respects rational equivalence, yielding CH_n(X)⊗CH_m(Y)→CH_{n+m−1}(X×_S Y). The base and dimension-function conventions are explicit.
statement:
Let $S$ be locally Noetherian, locally covered by affine spectra of Dedekind domains, with $\delta(s)=0$ at closed points and $\delta(s)=1$ at generic points of irreducible components. For locally finite type $S$-schemes $X,Y$, a $q$-cycle means a locally finite combination of integral closed subschemes of induced $\delta$-dimension $q$. Define exterior product on cycles by $[W]\times[V]=[W\times_SV]_{n+m-1}$ if at least one of the integral $W\subset X$, $V\subset Y$ dominates an irreducible component of $S$, and $0$ otherwise, for $\dim_\delta W=n,\dim_\delta V=m$. Extend bilinearly.

Let $S,X,Y$ and the dimension-shifted exterior product be as defined above. The map $\times : \mathrm{CH}_n(X) \otimes_{\mathbf{Z}} \mathrm{CH}_m(Y) \to
\mathrm{CH}_{n + m - 1}(X \times_S Y)$ is well defined.
